observations: Photo 0 shows a Mercedes transmission/gearbox casing laid on concrete; there is a label/plate area with a visible sticker that includes the number '460'.
Photo 0 also shows a separate round component (looks like a torque converter/flexplate-related part) placed behind/near the gearbox.
Photo 1 shows the gearbox bell/inner side with a large circular ring/plate and internal components visible; no clear model code is readable.
Photo 2 shows the gearbox from another angle with the side cover/outer housing and mounting points; no clear OEM part number readable.

claims.claim: Transmissions Gearbox M278 1282 OEM G63, Mercedes transmission gearbox.
claims.evidence: The photos show a Mercedes gearbox casing, but no clearly readable 'M278 1282' or 'G63' OEM identifier is visible in the provided images.
No test/bench run video, no mileage/vehicle details, and no diagnostic/test report is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Wrong transmission variant/fitment (different Mercedes models/gearbox codes can look similar externally).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the gearbox identification plate/label with the full transmission code/OEM number (not just the partial '460' sticker).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the gearbox being potentially the wrong variant (worst-case: buyer may need return/exchange or it may not fit).

risks.risk: Internal damage or missing parts (photos only show exterior; torque converter/valve body/clutches may be damaged).
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox internals/ports (openings) plus photos of all included components (torque converter, sensors, solenoids, valve body) laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed (worst-case: assume internal issues or incomplete kit).

risks.risk: Fluid leaks or housing cracks not visible from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seams, drain/plug areas, and any wet/oily spots; plus a wipe-clean then re-check after a short time (or a leak test note).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may require reseal/repair (worst-case: treat as leaking until proven otherwise).

risks.risk: Torque converter mismatch or condition uncertainty (a separate round unit is shown, but its exact pairing/part number is unclear).
risks.proof: Photo showing the torque converter part number and a clear statement/label that it matches this gearbox code; include both part numbers in one frame.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as converter condition/compatibility not confirmed (worst-case: assume converter may be faulty or not matching).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the gearbox identification plate/label showing the full transmission code/OEM number (the exact characters, not partially obscured).
Photo(s) of the torque converter/round component with its part number label, and confirmation it matches the gearbox code.
Video of the gearbox being tested/operated (or at least a bench test) showing it engages smoothly in all ranges.
Photos of all included sensors/solenoids/valve body components (laid out) to confirm completeness.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Mercedes gearbox, but the key identifiers needed to price correctly for Abuja fitment (exact transmission code/OEM and matching torque converter) are not readable, and the 'worked perfectly fine' claim is not supported by any test evidence.
